name: Task Rush
description: Compete in random short challenges. The player who does best overall wins!
task.highest_pos: Reach the highest position in the world you can.
task.lowest_pos: Reach the lowest position in the world you can.
task.mob_kills: Kill as many mobs as you can
task.water_distance: Move the most distance through water. Swimming and boats both count.
task.ore_collect: Collect the most ores. They do not need to be smelted.
task.fall_into_water: Fall the longest distance into a water block.
task.bow_distance: Hit a mob from the greatest distance with an arrow.
task.logs_collect: Collect the most logs of any type.
task.dive_deepest: Dive as deep into water as you can.
task.entity_damage: Deal the most damage to entities.
task.flower_types: Collect the most different types of flowers.
task.darkest_place: Find the darkest place. Breaking blocks is disabled.
task.stand_in_area: Stand alone in the marked area for as long as possible.
task.treasure_hunt: Be the first to find the treasure chest. Follow the map!
task.first_ore: Be the first to mine the shown ore.
task.breed_animals: Be the first to breed two animals.
task.reach_coords: Be the first to reach the target coordinates.
